name: FUN_FRC_SEARCH_ENTITIES
description: This table contains the entities for supporting enhanced search in financial reporting center.

columns.name: ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Unique sequence generated identifier for the entity.

columns.name: ENTITY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: This is the type of entity for which data is inserted. For example,  accounting flexfield, ledger.

columns.name: ENTITY_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Identifier for entity type. For exmple if entity type is accounting flexfield, then this is chart of account id.

columns.name: ENTITY_LANGUAGE
columns.description: The code of the language in which the entity was created.

columns.name: ENTITY_ATTRIBUTE
columns.description: Attribute associated with entity. For example, if the entity type is accounting flexfield, then this is segment value for chart of account segment.

columns.name: ENTITY_ATTRIBUTE_DESC1
columns.description: Property associated with entity attribute. For example, if the entity type is accounting flexfield and attribute is segment value, then this is segment value description for chart of account segment.

columns.name: ENTITY_ATTRIBUTE_DESC2
columns.description: Property associated with entity attribute. For example, if the entity type is accounting flexfield and attribute is segment value, then this is financial category for chart of account segment value.

columns.name: ENTITY_ATTRIBUTE_DESC3
columns.description: Property associated with entity attribute.  For example, if the entity type is  accounting flexfield and attribute is segment value, then this is account type for chart of account segment.

columns.name: ENTITY_ATTRIBUTE_DESC4
columns.description: Property associated with entity attribute.  For example, if the entity type is  accounting flexfield and attribute is segment value, then this is segment name for chart of account segment.

columns.name: ENTITY_ATTRIBUTE_DESC5
columns.description: Property associated with entity attribute.

columns.name: ENTITY_ATTRIBUTE_DESC6
columns.description: Property associated with entity attribute.

columns.name: ENTITY_ATTRIBUTE_DESC7
columns.description: Property associated with entity attribute.

columns.name: ENTITY_ATTRIBUTE_DESC8
columns.description: Property associated with entity attribute.

columns.name: ENTITY_ATTRIBUTE_DESC9
columns.description: Property associated with entity attribute.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.
